changelog:
v3.5.4 — Watchdog & Stability Fixes

• Fixed black screen loop on 1080p AVC content (AFTMM/AFTSSS) — watchdog now properly escalates to software decoder instead of looping seek flushes forever
• Fixed OOM crash on devices with 160-192MB heap class — buffer sizing threshold raised to prevent 60s buffer from filling memory
• Fixed VOD/Series grid crash (position -1) — additional Leanback GridLayoutManager safety guards
